Definition: adverb from G473; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.
BiblicalUsage: Above, on high, upward. The Jerusalem above is free and the mother of us all, and Paul presses toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus. The word lifts the eyes from earth to heaven.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for above carries no doctrine of its own; its direction is the point, that the Christian life is lived looking up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
